settings.title: Find your tag
settings.text: Each pair carries a numbered tag under the tongue, with a matching label on the box.

settings.title: Scan or enter the serial
settings.text: Scan the QR code with your phone camera, or type the serial (e.g. EVX-7F3K9QMD) below.

settings.title: View the certificate
settings.text: Genuine pairs open their own certificate, registered in the owner's name.
